s: Seder tepillat chag hashshabuot ubo k' seipim: beyom chamishshim lispirat haomer hu chag hashshabuot hanniqra atzeret bilshon chakamim, shenneemar "tisperu chamishshim yom vehiqrabtem vego' uqeratem beetzem hayyom hazzeh miqra qodesh vego'". Ulepi cheshbon qebiut hachodashim hammasur beyadenu shechodesh nisan hu male leolam vechodesh iyyar hu chaser leolam — yihyeh chag zeh beshishsha besivan, shehare yeme hassepira matchilin mit"z benisan, im ken t"v yom shemmit"z ad sop hachodesh vek"t yom shel iyyar veshishsha yamim besivan hem chamishshim yom. Lepikak anu omerim beshabuot: "zeman mattan toratenu", shebbeshishsha besivan nittena hattora leyisrael. Abal bizman shehayu meqaddeshin hachodashim al pi hareiyya haya epshar lihyot gam chodesh nisan chaser, vehaya chag hashshabuot, shehu yom chamishshim laomer, beshiba besivan. Veim haya gam chodesh iyyar male, haya chag hashshabuot, shehu yom chamishshim laomer, bachamishsha besivan. Ap sheeno beyom mattan tora — en bekak kelum, shehakkatub lo tala chag hazzeh beyom mattan tora, velo bekamma yamim lachodesh, raq bachamishshim laomer, ella shellepi cheshbon hammasur beyadenu leolam yihyeh yom chamishshim laomer beshishsha besivan shehu yom mattan tora. Veap sheshshishsha besivan shellanu hu yom n"a mit"v benisan shebbo yatzeu yisrael mimmitzrayim, vehattora nittena beyom n"b letzetam mimmitzrayim, shehare bachamishsha beshabbat yatzeu mimmitzrayim kemo shennitbaer besiman t"l, vehattora nittena "bachodesh hashshelishi" beyom hashshabbat, shehu shishsha besivan, shechodesh nisan veiyyar hayu az shenehem meleim, vekevan shet"v benisan haya chamishi bashshabbat haya yom rishon shel iyyar beshabbat, dehaynu [y"z] yom letzetam mimmitzrayim, veyom rishon shel sivan haya beyom b', dehaynu [m"z] yom letzetam mimmitzrayim, veshabbat hu shishsha besivan, dehaynu n"b yom letzetam mimmitzrayim, shehu yom n"a laomer — ap al pi ken anu omerim: "zeman mattan toratenu" bachamishshim laomer, kevan shehu lanu beshishsha besivan, ubeshishsha besivan nittena hattora:

Ap al pi shebbekol arbe yom tob nohagin lehaqdim tepillat arbit shel yom tob mibbeod yom mittaam shennitbaer besiman rs"z, mikkol maqom belel shabuot meacharin lehitpallel leachar tzet hakkokabim, sheim yaqdimu viqabbelu qedushshat yom tob bitpilla mibbeod yom — hare zeh kemo shechisseru meat mim"t yeme hassepira shellipne chag hazzeh, vehattora omra: "sheba shabbatot temimot tihyena. Umizzeh hattaam en leqaddesh gam ken qiddush hayyom mibbeod yom ap qodem tepillat arbit:

Nohagin harbeh lihyot neorim kol hallayla laasoq battora (umikkol maqom, im hu lel tebila — yeshammesh mittato, ayyen siman r"m), veiqqar haeseq yihyeh betora shebbeal peh. Utzerikim hem lizzaher shello lebarek "al netilat yadayim" babboqer" ayyen siman d', veshello lebarek al hattallit qatan shehaya labush bo ballayla ayyen siman ch'. Veim yebareku birkat hattora babboqer — nitbaer besiman m"z, ayyen sham:

Beyom a' shel shabuot achar gemar hahallel (vekol dine hahallel beyom zeh nitbaer besiman tp"ch) motziin b' sipre tora mittaam shennitbaer besiman tp"ch. Veqorin beseper tora a' chamishsha gabre beparashat yitro: "bachodesh hashshelishi letzet" ad sop hassidra, shehu inyano shel yom shebbo nittena hattora. Vehammaptir qore beseper tora b' beparashat pinchas: "ubeyom habbikkurim vego'". Umaptir bannabi bemerkaba dichezqel, al shem shennigla haqqadosh baruk hu besinay beribbo rebabot "alpe shinan". Venohagin lesayyem bappasuq "vattissaeni ruach", ap sheeno katub kelal etzel hammerkaba:
Venohagin bemiqtzat meqomot sheggadol vechakam qore zot hahaptara. Vesemek laddabar: "velo bemaaseh merkaba, ella im ken haya chakam umebin middato":

Yesh nohagin leomrah meummad, velo hammaptir bilbad shehu tzarik laamod lekattechilla bekol hahaptarot mippene kebod hatztzibbur, ella ap kol mi sheqqore otah belachash im hammaptir qoreah meummad, mippene kebodah:

Hannohagin leshorer "aqdamut" achar sheqqareu battora pasuq rishon, ap al pi shemmapsiqin beemtza haqqeria bedabar sheeno tzorek haqqeria — en limchot beyadam, ki yesh shemmeyashshebin minhagam. Abal bemaqom sheen minhag, yoter tob leshorer "aqdamut" qodem sheyyatchil hakkohen lebarek lipne qeriat hattora. Veken "yatztzib pitgam" beyom sheni, yoter tob lomar qodem sheyyatchil hammaptir lebarek lipne hahaptara. Veken nahagu akshav beharbeh meqomot:

Baaseret haddibberot yesh b' mine neginot: haechad oseh mikkol dibbur pasuq echad, ap shehu arok o qatzar meod, dehaynu she"anoki", ve"lo yihyeh leka", ve"lo taaseh leka", ve"lo tishtachaveh", "veoseh chesed", hem pasuq echad, she"anoki" ve"lo yihyeh leka" bedibbur echad neemru. Ulepikak tebat "panay" hannu"n nequda patta"ch velo qama"tz, shehare en sham etnachta velo sop pasuq. Veken "zakor", ve"sheshet yamim", "veyom hashshebii", ve"ki sheshet", hem pasuq echad. Ulepikak hakka"p shel tebat "kol" hassemuka letebat "veasita" hi repuya velo degusha. Ub' tebot "lo tirtzach" hem pasuq echad shalem. Ulepikak hatztzadi"y hi nequda qama"tz, kevan sheyyesh sham sop pasuq, vehattay"v degusha, lepi shettebat "lo" hi mutemet betaam mapsiq, dehaynu tippecha. Veken "lo tinap" hu pasuq echad shalem, vehattay"v degusha vehaale"p nequda qama"tz. Veken "lo tignob", hattay"v degusha:

Vehashsheni oseh me"anoki" pasuq echad, umi"lo yihyeh leka" pasuq shene. Ulepi zeh hannu"n shel "panai" hu beqama"tz, sheyyesh sham sop pasuq. Veken "zakor" hu pasuq echad, ve"sheshet yamim" hu pasuq sheni. Ulepi zeh hakka"p shel tebat "kol" hi degusha. "Lo tirtzach", ve"lo tinap", ve"lo tignob", ve"lo taaneh", hakkol pasuq echad. Ulepi zeh kol tay"v mehem repuya, vehatztzadi"y shel "tirtzach" hi bepattach, vehaalep shel "tinap" hi beqamatz, lepi sheyyesh sham etnachta:

Vetaam b' neginot hu, sheharishon hu mesuddar lepi hakkatub, shenniktab kol dibbur vedibbur beparasha bipne atzmah, shemme"anoki" ad "lo tissa" hi parasha achat setuma vedibbur echad, lekak naasa mimmennu pasuq echad. Veken mi"zakor" ad "lo tirtzach". Abal mi"lo tirtzach" ad "lo tachmod" niktab bed' parashiyyot setumot, vehem d' dibburim, lekak naasa mehem d' pesuqim:

Vehashsheni hu mesuddar lepi haqqeri, shelleinyan haqqeria en mi"lo tirtzach" ad "lo tachmod" ella pasuq echad bilbad, dehaynu sheasur lehapsiq qeriato legamre betok emtza pasuq zeh apillu kesheqqore beyachid, shekkol hapsaqot happesuqim hem halaka lemosheh missinay, veasur lehapsiq bemaqom shello pasaq lanu mosheh missinay, vekevan sheasur lehapsiq haqqeria legamre beemtza d' parashiyyot qetannot hallalu, im ken gam kesheqqorein bepaam echad — hem niqraim bingina hamchabberet otan laasot mikkullan pasuq echad, kemo shehem beemet pasuq echad, sheen lanu bekol hattora pasuq pachot mig' tebot. Veken me"anoki" ad "lo tissa", umi"zakor" ad "lo tirtzach", hen mupsaqim lekamma pesuqim leinyan haqqeria, dehaynu leinyan shehayyachid muttar lehapsiq qeriato legamre beemtza parashat "anoki" ve"zakor", raq sheyyihyeh besop pasuq. Veap betzibbur en issur lehapsiq sham ella mishshum hanniknasin veyotzein, kemo shennitbaer besiman ql"ch, lekak hem niqraim bingina hammapseqet otan laasot mehen kamma pesuqim, kemo shehen beemet kamma pesuqim leinyan minyan happesuqim. Umikkol maqom, baatzeret nohagin liqrot betzibbur beharishon, laasot mikkol dibbur pasuq echad, lepi shebbo bayyom nittenu aseret haddibberot, lekak qorin oto kemo shennittenu kol dibbur bepasuq echad. Veyesh nohagin liqrot betzibbur beharishon leolam, ap beshabbat parashat yitro ubeshabbat parashat vaetchannan, raq hayyachid haqqore leatzmo — qore bashsheni:

Beyom tob sheni qorin chamishsha gabre beparashat "kol habbekor", vehammaptir qore battora "ubeyom habbikkurim" kemo barishon, umaptir bannabi "tepilla lachabaqquq" ad "lamnatztzeach binginotai". Veyesh meqomot shemmatchilin min "veHashem behekal qodsho":

Nohagin liqrot megillat rut beshabuot shehu zeman mattan tora, kede lilmod shello nittena tora ella al yede yissurin veoni kemo shehaya lerut keshennitgayyera. Veen mebarekin kelum al qeriat megilla zo, kemo shennitbaer besiman t"tz:

Venohagin lishtoach asabim bebet hakkeneset ubabbattim beshabuot, zeker lesimchat mattan tora. Veap beyom tob atzmo muttar leshotchan apillu im enan reuyin lemaakal, veen bahem issur muqtzeh, kevan shechashab alehen meereb yom tob leshotchan beyom tob, ayyen siman sh"ch. Umikkol maqom, im chal shabuot achar hashshabbat — lo yishtechem beshabbat. Ap shemmuttar letaltelam, mikkol maqom kesheshshotchan beshabbat letzorek yom tob — hare zeh kemo mekin mishshabbat leyom tob, veasur lehakin kelum mishshabbat leyom tob apillu bedabar sheen bo shum serek melaka, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"g:
Nohagin lehaamid ilanot bebet hakkeneset ubabbattim, kede lehazkir shebbaatzeret niddonin al perot hailan veyitpallelu alehem:

Nohagin bekol hammeqomot leekol maakle chalab beyom a' shel shabuot, uminhag abotenu tora hi, ki harbeh teamim neemru alayv. Ulepi shemmitzva leekol basar bekol yom tob kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqk"t, lepikak tzerikin lehizzaher shello yabou lide issur basar bechalab, veyaasu kakkatub beyoreh dea siman p"ch vp"t. Vehannohagim leepot lechem nillosh bechalab o bechema — yizzaharu keshemmassiqin hattannur qodem haapiyya sheyyassiquhu yapeh beinyan sheyyihyu nitztzotzot nittazin mimmennu, kede lehaplit mimmennu et roteb shel basar shennishpak alayv lipamim venibla betoko (vesheyyihyu haggechalim mehallekim al pene kullo, ayyen siman ts"a). Veken yizzaharu liqqach mardeh chadasha lehotzi bah lechem zeh min hattannur. Velo yotziuhu bemardeh shemmotziin bah shear kol hallechamim sheenan shel chalab, apillu im rotzim lehapekah al tziddah hashsheni, lepi sheakshav yehe nibla bah taam hechalab bekol obyah kesheyyotziu bah lechem nillosh bechalab, veachar kak kesheyyopu lechem acher leoklo im basar veyotziuhu bemardeh zo — yehe niplat mimmennu taam hechalab veyibbala ballechem (kede qelipa, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"a). Veap sheim abar veasa ken muttar leekol lechem hahu im basar, lepi shehu noten taam bar noten taam shel hetter, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"d, mikkol maqom hare lekattechilla asur laasot noten taam bar noten taam, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"h. (Vedin hechalab shennechelab beyom tob — yitbaer besiman tq"h ayyen sham):

Hamchalleq isbe besamim lehatztzibbur bebet hakkeneset — yizzaher shello lechalleq lahem mi"baruk sheamar" ad leachar shemoneh esreh, sheqqodem "baruk sheamar" o leachar shemoneh esreh yekolin hen lebarek al hareach hammaggia lahem, abal mi"baruk sheamar" ad leachar shemoneh esreh asur lehapsiq bedibbur veyehaneh mehareach belo beraka, sheapillu ben pereq lepereq shemmuttar lehapsiq apillu bishbil kebod basar vadam — ap al pi ken asur lehapsiq lebarek al hareach, lepi shebberaka zo enah choba kelal, shehare en tzarik lebarek al hareach ella keshemmitkavven lehariach, abal im hareach maggia lo meelayv vehu eno mitkavven elayv ap shebbeal korcho nehena mimmennu — eno mebarek alayv kemo shennitbaer besiman ry"z, im ken zeh sheomed bemaqom sheasur lehapsiq — lo yitkavven lehariach velo yapsiq lebarek al hareach:

Asur lehitannot taanit chalom bechag hashshabuot, lepi shehu yom shennittena bo hattora, vetzarik leekol velismoach bo, leharot shennoach umequbbal leyisrael yom shennittena bo hattora, lepikak eno domeh lishar yamim tobim veshabbatot shemmuttar lehitannot bahem taanit chalom kemo shennitbaer besiman rp"ch:

Bemotzae chag hashshabuot asur lehitannot meiqqar haddin, lepi shehaya "yom tabuach" bizman shebbet hammiqdash qayyam, dehaynu shebbo bayyom hayu maqribin olot reiyya shello hayu yekolin lehaqrib beyom tob atzmo, lepi sheen bahem shum tzorek okel nepesh, veen mechallelin yom tob bishbilam, kevan sheepshar lehaqriban achar yom tob, shehaatzeret yesh lah tashlumin kol shiba. Veap al pi shezzeh hu ledibre bet shammay, abal ledibre bet hillel muttar lehaqriban ap beyom tob atzmo, mikkol maqom kevan shebbedabar zeh asu bet hillel kedibrehem, veharbeh miyyisrael nahagu kemotam lehaqriban achar yom tob, venaasa lahem yom zeh shehu motzae yom tob kemo yom tob atzmo leheaser bo behesped vetaanit, im ken ap atta mishshecharab bet hammiqdash — lo huttera hahesped vehattaanit bo bayyom. Abal bemotzae yom tob haacharon shel pesach veshel sukkot lo haya "yom tabuach" ap ledibre bet shammay, shekkol olot reiyya hayu niqrabot bemotzae yom tob harishon shehu chullo shel moed, lepikak en bahem issur lehitannot meiqqar haddin ella mechamat minhag beolma, kemo shennitbaer besiman tk"t:

Venohagin bimdinot ellu shello lehitannot veshello lomar tachanun merosh chodesh ad ch' bo vead biklal, dehaynu ad achar motzae yom tob hanniqra "isru chag", lepi shemmiyyad achar rosh chodesh hitchil mosheh lehitasseq immahem beinyan qabbalat hattora, shebbashsheni bashshabbat haya rosh chodesh, ubashshelishi bashshabbat amar lahem: "veattem tihyu li mamleket kohanim vego'", ubarebii amar lahem mitzvat hagbala: "hishshameru lakem alot bahar vego'", ubachamishi amar lahem mitzvat perisha, sheyyipreshu minneshotehen "hayyom umachar", veyihyu nekonim "layyom hashshelishi" shehu shabbat, shebbo nittena hattora: seliq siman ttz"d useliq kol hilkot pesach:
